title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Driving Snow Pharaoh's Servant PSV-018 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is known as Driving Snow, from the set Pharaoh's Servant. It is a common card with the rarity of 1st edition. This trap card has the attribute of MTG:Color and the creature/monster type of trap. The card number is PSV-018 and it is highly sought after by collectors and players alike.
